description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of different video understanding models as a function of the number of frames. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and is a linear scale ranging from 10 to 60. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and is a linear scale ranging from 40 to 54. The plot includes four lines representing different models: "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" is a blue line with circle markers and a solid line style, "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" is a green line with circle markers and a solid line style, "PLLaVA (DP 8)" is an orange line with square markers and a solid line style, and "PLLaVA (DP 16)" is a red line with square markers and a solid line style. The "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" and "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" lines start at an accuracy of approximately 54% and remain relatively stable across the number of frames. The "PLLaVA (DP 8)" and "PLLaVA (DP 16)" lines start at an accuracy of approximately 42% and show a decline in accuracy as the number of frames increases.
